title: Compliance Worksheet: Measured Zero-Tolerance Increase and Cure Amount on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Measured increase.** The measured increase of the zero-tolerance cure on a Mortgage Loan File is the zero-tolerance total on the latest Loan Estimate on the file, the one with the highest disclosure sequence, minus the zero-tolerance total on the initial Loan Estimate, kept with its sign, so that it is negative when the latest total is the lower one; a total the file does not carry counts as 0.00.

**Standard cure.** The standard zero-tolerance cure is the measured increase where it is above zero, and nothing otherwise.

**How the cure is put together.** Each amount taken out or added back adjusts the signed measured increase once, in dollars; the cure is that adjusted increase where it is above zero and nothing otherwise, rounded to the cent.

**Records read.** Both totals come from the file's disclosure history: the zero-tolerance total recorded on the initial Loan Estimate, and the zero-tolerance total recorded on the Loan Estimate with the highest disclosure sequence (the initial one where no revision exists).

## Standard cure worked through (hypothetical files)

| Initial Loan Estimate zero-tolerance total | Latest Loan Estimate zero-tolerance total | Measured increase | Standard cure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2972.30 USD | 3384.80 USD | 412.50 USD | 412.50 USD |
| 2972.30 USD | 2900.00 USD | minus 72.30 USD | nothing |
| 2972.30 USD | 2972.30 USD (no revision) | 0.00 USD | nothing |
| 9417.30 USD | 9417.31 USD | 0.01 USD | 0.01 USD |
